Name: Marnie Sells More
Author: GingerNinja7921
Description:
"Marnie Sells More" is an exciting expansion mod available for Stardew Valley that both extends the game's story and improves overall gameplay. Specifically, it does so by providing players with a wider range of items that can purchased from Marnie's shop.


The mod adds exotic and rare items to the inventory, like Magic Rock Candy, Rabbit Fur Cloth, and Caviar, as well as more basic items like Pancakes, Omelets, and Fried Eggs. Along with these new items, the mod also adjusts prices based on player progress, providing greater value for in-game currency.

One of the best features of this mod is that items are priced differently based on time of year and other factors. The graded pricing system means that players are always getting the most for their money. Some of the additional items that can be purchased using this mod include a variety of wines, cloths, and different types of fruit and mushrooms.

Players who use "Marnie Sells More" find Marnie's shop to be an essential in-game marketplace for rare and unique items, not available elsewhere. The mod adds a new element of excitement to the Stardew Valley gameplay experience, making it an absolute must-have addition to any Stardew Valley player's mod collection.

Downloads.Description: Base mod and first version of the mod, currently in working order.
